_comment: Release log and release notes (spec 7.4, fingerprint dimension 19; read by scripts/lib/fingerprint.ts and scripts/sync.ts). Add a submission line, by hand, the day a build goes to a store: {"version", "store": "apple" | "google", "date": ISO, "build", "scan": the scan-binary.ts output file}. The first submission must be at least 14 days after Orbit Haulers' latest one (spec 1.2, dimension 19).

releaseNotes.1.0.0: The lanterns are lit on Lantern Row. Six stalls, twenty lanterns to earn, and the first customers wait at the counters with their tickets.
